import pddl = "./pddl_parser.qui"
import grounding = "./grounding.qui"
import search = "./search.qui"

class Pair(int first, int second)
class Element(int action, int[] pre, int[] add, int[] del)
class Level(Element[] elements, Pair[] mutexes)
class Extraction(Level[] levels := [], memo := distinct<string>(), searched := 0, hits := 0, tried := 0)
class GraphResult(search.Result result, int[][] layers, string[] records, int hits)

Pair pair(int first, int second)
    return if first < second then Pair(first, second) else Pair(second, first)

bool compatible(const int[] facts, const Pair[] mutexes)
    for first := facts[]
        for second := facts[]
            if first != second and pddl.has(mutexes, pair(first, second))
                return false
    return true

int[][] | none extract(Extraction &context, int level_number, const int[] goals);

int[][] | none assign(Extraction &context, int level_number, const int[] goals, int position, const int[] chosen)
    level := context.levels[level_number - 1]
    current := position
    while current < int(#goals)
        covered := false
        for index := chosen[]
            if pddl.has(level.elements[index].add, goals[current])
                covered = true
        if not covered
            break
        current += 1
    if current == int(#goals)
        int[] previous := []
        int[] layer_actions := []
        for index := chosen[]
            previous = pddl.unique(previous.concat(level.elements[index].pre))
            if level.elements[index].action >= 0
                layer_actions = layer_actions.append(level.elements[index].action)
        match extract(&context, level_number - 1, previous.sorted())
            int[][] plan
                return plan.append(layer_actions.sorted())
            none
                return none
    goal := goals[current]
    int[] achievers := []
    for: index < int(#level.elements)
        entry := level.elements[index]
        if entry.action < 0 and pddl.has(entry.add, goal)
            achievers = achievers.append(index)
    for: index < int(#level.elements)
        entry := level.elements[index]
        if entry.action >= 0 and pddl.has(entry.add, goal)
            achievers = achievers.append(index)
    for index := achievers[]
        eligible := true
        for other := chosen[]
            if index != other and pddl.has(level.mutexes, pair(index, other))
                eligible = false
        if eligible
            context.tried += 1
            match assign(&context, level_number, goals, current + 1, chosen.append(index))
                int[][] plan
                    return plan
                none
                    continue
    return none

int[][] | none extract(Extraction &context, int level_number, const int[] goals)
    if level_number == 0
        return []
    key := "{level_number}:{search.state_key(goals)}"
    if context.memo.has(key)
        context.hits += 1
        return none
    context.searched += 1
    match assign(&context, level_number, goals, 0, [])
        int[][] plan
            return plan
        none
            .context.memo.add(key)
            return none

GraphResult run(const grounding.Action[] actions, const int[] initial, const int[] goals, int limit)
    context := Extraction()
    facts := initial
    Pair[] mutexes := []
    previous_facts := -1
    previous_mutexes := -1
    string[] records := []
    int[][] answer := []
    status := "level limit"
    for: level_number < limit + 1
        records = records.append("fact level {level_number}: facts={#facts} mutexes={#mutexes}")
        attempted := pddl.contains_all(facts, goals) and compatible(goals, mutexes)
        if attempted
            before_searched := context.searched
            before_hits := context.hits
            success := false
            match extract(&context, level_number, goals.sorted())
                int[][] plan
                    answer = plan
                    success = true
                none
                    success = false
            result_word := if success then "success" else "fail"
            records = records.append("extract level {level_number}: {result_word} searched={context.searched - before_searched} memo_hits={context.hits - before_hits}")
            if success
                status = "solved"
                break
        elif previous_facts == int(#facts) and previous_mutexes == int(#mutexes)
            status = "unreachable"
            break
        if level_number == limit
            break
        previous_facts = int(#facts)
        previous_mutexes = int(#mutexes)
        Element[] elements := []
        for: index < int(#actions)
            action := actions[index]
            if pddl.contains_all(facts, action.pre) and compatible(action.pre, mutexes)
                elements = elements.append(Element(index, action.pre, action.add, action.del))
        real_count := int(#elements)
        ordered_facts := facts.sorted()
        for fact := ordered_facts[]
            elements = elements.append(Element(-1, [fact], [fact], []))
        Pair[] action_mutexes := []
        for: first < int(#elements)
            for: first + 1 <= second < int(#elements)
                left := elements[first]
                right := elements[second]
                conflict := pddl.overlaps(left.del, right.pre.concat(right.add)) or pddl.overlaps(right.del, left.pre.concat(left.add))
                for left_pre := left.pre[]
                    for right_pre := right.pre[]
                        if left_pre != right_pre and pddl.has(mutexes, pair(left_pre, right_pre))
                            conflict = true
                if conflict
                    action_mutexes = action_mutexes.append(pair(first, second))
        records = records.append("action level {level_number}: actions={real_count} noops={#facts} mutexes={#action_mutexes}")
        int[] next := []
        for entry := elements[]
            next = pddl.unique(next.concat(entry.add))
        next = next.sorted()
        Pair[] next_mutexes := []
        for: first < int(#next)
            for: first + 1 <= second < int(#next)
                impossible := true
                for: left < int(#elements)
                    if not pddl.has(elements[left].add, next[first])
                        continue
                    for: right < int(#elements)
                        if pddl.has(elements[right].add, next[second]) and (left == right or not pddl.has(action_mutexes, pair(left, right)))
                            impossible = false
                if impossible
                    next_mutexes = next_mutexes.append(pair(next[first], next[second]))
        context.levels = context.levels.append(Level(elements, action_mutexes))
        facts = next
        mutexes = next_mutexes
    int[] flat := []
    for layer := answer[]
        flat = flat.concat(layer)
    return GraphResult(search.Result(status, flat, context.searched, context.tried), answer, records, context.hits)

import pddl = "./pddl_parser.qui"

class Action(int source, string name, string[] args, int cost, int[] pre, int[] neg, int[] add, int[] del)
    string text()
        return pddl.Atom(name, args).text()

class Grounding(pddl.Atom[] facts, Action[] actions, int[] initial, int[] goals, pddl.Atom[] unreachable, int[][] stats, string[] fluent, int static_count)
class Candidate(int source, string[] args, pddl.Atom[] pre := [], pddl.Atom[] neg := [], pddl.Atom[] add := [], pddl.Atom[] del := [])

bool subtype(const pddl.Domain domain, string actual, string expected)
    current := actual
    while true
        if current == expected
            return true
        match domain.parents.get(current)
            string parent
                current = parent
            none
                return false

string[] fluents(const pddl.Domain domain)
    string[] result := []
    for schema := domain.actions[]
        for effect := schema.effects[]
            if not pddl.has(result, effect.atom.predicate)
                result = result.append(effect.atom.predicate)
    return result

void combinations(const string[][] choices, int position, const string[] current, string[][] &result)
    if position == int(#choices)
        result = result.append(current)
        return
    for value := choices[position][]
        combinations(choices, position + 1, current.append(value), &result)

int | error find_name(const string[] names, string sought)
    for: position < int(#names)
        if names[position] == sought
            return position
    return error("missing name")

int[] numbers(const pddl.Atom[] facts, const pddl.Atom[] items)
    int[] result := []
    for: position < int(#facts)
        if pddl.has(items, facts[position])
            result = result.append(position)
    return result

Grounding ground(const pddl.Domain domain, const pddl.Problem problem)
    fluent := fluents(domain)
    int[][] stats := array(#domain.actions, fill = [0, 0, 0])
    Candidate[] candidates := []
    for: source < int(#domain.actions)
        pddl.Schema schema := domain.actions[source]
        string[][] choices := []
        for parameter := schema.parameters[]
            string[] eligible := []
            for object_value := problem.objects[]
                if subtype(domain, object_value.type, parameter.type)
                    eligible = eligible.append(object_value.name)
            choices = choices.append(eligible)
        string[][] assignments := []
        combinations(choices, 0, [], &assignments)
        stats[source][0] = int(#assignments)
        for args := assignments[]
            map<string, string> bindings
            for: index < int(#args)
                .bindings.set(schema.parameters[index].name, args[index])
            candidate := Candidate(source, args)
            valid := true
            for condition := schema.pre[]
                item := pddl.replace(condition.atom, bindings)
                if item.predicate == "=" or not pddl.has(fluent, item.predicate)
                    truth := if item.predicate == "=" then item.terms[0] == item.terms[1] else pddl.has(problem.initial, item)
                    if truth == condition.negative
                        valid = false
                        break
                elif condition.negative
                    candidate.neg = pddl.unique(candidate.neg.append(item))
                else
                    candidate.pre = pddl.unique(candidate.pre.append(item))
            if not valid
                continue
            for effect := schema.effects[]
                item := pddl.replace(effect.atom, bindings)
                if effect.negative
                    candidate.del = pddl.unique(candidate.del.append(item))
                else
                    candidate.add = pddl.unique(candidate.add.append(item))
            candidate.del = pddl.subtract(candidate.del, candidate.add)
            stats[source][1] += 1
            candidates = candidates.append(candidate)
    pddl.Atom[] reachable := []
    static_count := 0
    for item := problem.initial[]
        if pddl.has(fluent, item.predicate)
            reachable = reachable.append(item)
        else
            static_count += 1
    kept := array(#candidates, fill = false)
    while true
        changed := false
        for: index < int(#candidates)
            if pddl.contains_all(reachable, candidates[index].pre)
                if not kept[index]
                    kept[index] = true
                    changed = true
                reachable = pddl.unique(reachable.concat(candidates[index].add))
        if not changed
            break
    string[] predicate_names := []
    for declaration := domain.predicates[]
        predicate_names = predicate_names.append(declaration.name)
    string[] object_names := []
    for object_value := problem.objects[]
        object_names = object_names.append(object_value.name)
    facts := reachable
    int[][] keys := []
    for item := facts[]
        predicate_index := find_name(predicate_names, item.predicate)
        key := [predicate_index]
        for term := item.terms[]
            object_index := find_name(object_names, term)
            key = key.append(object_index)
        keys = keys.append(key)
    for: index < int(#facts)
        position := index
        while position > 0 and pddl.compare(keys[position], keys[position - 1]) < 0
            saved := facts[position]
            facts[position] = facts[position - 1]
            facts[position - 1] = saved
            saved_key := keys[position]
            keys[position] = keys[position - 1]
            keys[position - 1] = saved_key
            position -= 1
    Action[] actions := []
    for: index < int(#candidates)
        if not kept[index]
            continue
        candidate := candidates[index]
        pddl.Schema schema := domain.actions[candidate.source]
        stats[candidate.source][2] += 1
        actions = actions.append(Action(candidate.source, schema.name, candidate.args, schema.cost, numbers(facts, candidate.pre), numbers(facts, candidate.neg), numbers(facts, candidate.add), numbers(facts, candidate.del)))
    goals := numbers(facts, problem.goals)
    pddl.Atom[] unreachable := []
    for item := problem.goals[]
        if not pddl.has(facts, item) and (pddl.has(fluent, item.predicate) or not pddl.has(problem.initial, item))
            unreachable = unreachable.append(item)
    return Grounding(facts, actions, numbers(facts, problem.initial), goals, unreachable, stats, fluent, static_count)

import pddl = "./pddl_parser.qui"
import grounding = "./grounding.qui"

const INFINITY := 1000000000000
class Relaxed(int value, int[] plan := [], int[] helpful := [])

bool applicable(const grounding.Action action, const int[] state)
    return pddl.contains_all(state, action.pre) and not pddl.overlaps(state, action.neg)

int aggregate(const int[] values, bool maximum)
    result := 0
    for entry := values[]
        if entry >= INFINITY
            return INFINITY
        if maximum
            if entry > result
                result = entry
        else
            result += entry
    return result

int[] costs(const grounding.Grounding graph, const int[] state, bool maximum)
    result := array(#graph.facts, fill = INFINITY)
    for fact := state[]
        result[fact] = 0
    while true
        changed := false
        for action := graph.actions[]
            int[] previous := []
            for fact := action.pre[]
                previous = previous.append(result[fact])
            candidate_cost := aggregate(previous, maximum)
            if candidate_cost >= INFINITY
                continue
            candidate_cost += action.cost
            for fact := action.add[]
                if candidate_cost < result[fact]
                    result[fact] = candidate_cost
                    changed = true
        if not changed
            return result

int | error achiever(const grounding.Grounding graph, const int[] fact_costs, int fact)
    selected := -1
    best := INFINITY
    for: index < int(#graph.actions)
        grounding.Action action := graph.actions[index]
        if not pddl.has(action.add, fact)
            continue
        int[] pre_costs := []
        for pre := action.pre[]
            pre_costs = pre_costs.append(fact_costs[pre])
        candidate_cost := aggregate(pre_costs, false)
        if candidate_cost >= INFINITY
            continue
        candidate_cost += action.cost
        if selected < 0 or candidate_cost < best
            selected = index
            best = candidate_cost
    if selected < 0
        return error("missing achiever")
    return selected

Relaxed relaxed(const grounding.Grounding graph, const int[] state)
    fact_costs := costs(graph, state, false)
    for goal := graph.goals[]
        if fact_costs[goal] >= INFINITY
            return Relaxed(INFINITY)
    int[] chosen := []
    int[] pending := pddl.subtract(graph.goals, state)
    while #pending != 0
        fact := pending[-1]
        pending = pending[0:<int(#pending) - 1]
        action := achiever(graph, fact_costs, fact)
        if not pddl.has(chosen, action)
            chosen = chosen.append(action)
            pending = pending.concat(pddl.subtract(graph.actions[action].pre, state))
    plan := chosen.sorted()
    int[] helpful := []
    total := 0
    for action := plan[]
        total += graph.actions[action].cost
        if applicable(graph.actions[action], state)
            helpful = helpful.append(action)
    return Relaxed(total, plan, helpful)

int[] | none landmarks(const grounding.Grounding graph, const int[] state)
    fact_levels := array(#graph.facts, fill = INFINITY)
    action_levels := array(#graph.actions, fill = INFINITY)
    for fact := state[]
        fact_levels[fact] = 0
    level := 0
    while true
        added := false
        for: index < int(#graph.actions)
            grounding.Action action := graph.actions[index]
            eligible := action_levels[index] == INFINITY
            for fact := action.pre[]
                if fact_levels[fact] > level
                    eligible = false
            if eligible
                action_levels[index] = level
                for fact := action.add[]
                    if fact_levels[fact] == INFINITY
                        fact_levels[fact] = level + 1
                        added = true
        if not added
            break
        level += 1
    for fact := graph.goals[]
        if fact_levels[fact] == INFINITY
            return none
    int[] result := pddl.subtract(graph.goals, state)
    while true
        before := int(#result)
        ordered := result.sorted()
        for fact := ordered[]
            int[] achievers := []
            for: index < int(#graph.actions)
                if action_levels[index] < INFINITY and action_levels[index] + 1 == fact_levels[fact] and pddl.has(graph.actions[index].add, fact)
                    achievers = achievers.append(index)
            int[] candidates := graph.actions[achievers[0]].pre
            for: 1 <= position < int(#achievers)
                candidates = pddl.intersect(candidates, graph.actions[achievers[position]].pre)
            candidates = pddl.subtract(candidates, state).sorted()
            for candidate := candidates[]
                if pddl.has(result, candidate)
                    continue
                reachable := state
                while true
                    old := int(#reachable)
                    for action := graph.actions[]
                        if not pddl.has(action.add, candidate) and pddl.contains_all(reachable, action.pre)
                            reachable = pddl.unique(reachable.concat(action.add))
                    if old == int(#reachable)
                        break
                if not pddl.contains_all(reachable, graph.goals)
                    result = result.append(candidate)
        if before == int(#result)
            return result.sorted()

int value(const grounding.Grounding graph, const int[] state, string name)
    if name == "none"
        return 0
    if name == "goalcount"
        return int(#pddl.subtract(graph.goals, state))
    if name == "hmax" or name == "hadd"
        maximum := name == "hmax"
        fact_costs := costs(graph, state, maximum)
        int[] goal_costs := []
        for fact := graph.goals[]
            goal_costs = goal_costs.append(fact_costs[fact])
        return aggregate(goal_costs, maximum)
    if name == "ff"
        return relaxed(graph, state).value
    match landmarks(graph, state)
        int[] found
            return int(#found)
        none
            return INFINITY

int[] values(const grounding.Grounding graph, const int[] state)
    names := ["goalcount", "hmax", "hadd", "ff", "lmcount"]
    int[] result := []
    for name := names[]
        result = result.append(value(graph, state, name))
    return result

import pddl = "./pddl_parser.qui"
import grounding = "./grounding.qui"
import heuristics = "./heuristics.qui"
import search = "./search.qui"
import graphplan = "./graphplan.qui"

string | none arguments(const pddl.Domain domain, const string[] args, const string[] expected, const map<string, string> table, string noun)
    if #args != #expected
        return "expected {#expected} arguments, got {#args}"
    for: position < int(#args)
        match table.get(args[position])
            string actual
                if not grounding.subtype(domain, actual, expected[position])
                    return "argument {position + 1} ({args[position]}) is not of type {expected[position]}"
            none
                return "unknown {noun} {args[position]}"
    return none

string | none atom_error(const pddl.Domain domain, const pddl.Atom item, const map<string, string> table, string noun, bool equality)
    if equality and item.predicate == "="
        return arguments(domain, item.terms, ["object", "object"], table, noun)
    for declaration := domain.predicates[]
        if declaration.name == item.predicate
            return arguments(domain, item.terms, declaration.types, table, noun)
    return "unknown predicate {item.predicate}"

map<string, string> type_table(const pddl.Typed[] entries)
    map<string, string> result
    for entry := entries[]
        .result.set(entry.name, entry.type)
    return result

void validate_domain(pddl.Domain &domain)
    pddl.Schema[] actions := []
    for schema := domain.actions[]
        string | none reason := none
        for parameter := schema.parameters[]
            if not pddl.has(domain.type_order, parameter.type)
                reason = "unknown type {parameter.type}"
                break
        match reason
            string message
                domain.diagnostics = domain.diagnostics.append("error: action {schema.name}: {message}")
                continue
            none
                void
        table := type_table(schema.parameters)
        pddl.Literal[] literals := schema.pre.concat(schema.effects)
        for entry := literals[]
            match atom_error(domain, entry.atom, table, "variable", true)
                string message
                    reason = "{entry.atom.text()}: {message}"
                    break
                none
                    continue
        match reason
            string message
                domain.diagnostics = domain.diagnostics.append("error: action {schema.name}: {message}")
            none
                actions = actions.append(schema)
    domain.actions = actions
    for declaration := domain.predicates[]
        used := false
        for schema := domain.actions[]
            pddl.Literal[] literals := schema.pre.concat(schema.effects)
            for entry := literals[]
                if entry.atom.predicate == declaration.name
                    used = true
        if not used
            domain.diagnostics = domain.diagnostics.append("warning: predicate {declaration.name} is not used by any action")

void validate_problem(const pddl.Domain domain, pddl.Problem &problem)
    table := type_table(problem.objects)
    for: side < 2
        pddl.Atom[] original := if side == 0 then problem.initial else problem.goals
        pddl.Atom[] kept := []
        side_name := if side == 0 then "init" else "goal"
        for item := original[]
            string | none reason := atom_error(domain, item, table, "object", false)
            match reason
                string message
                    problem.diagnostics = problem.diagnostics.append("warning: {side_name} {item.text()}: {message}")
                none
                    if pddl.has(kept, item)
                        problem.diagnostics = problem.diagnostics.append("warning: {side_name} {item.text()}: duplicate")
                    else
                        kept = kept.append(item)
        if side == 0
            problem.initial = kept
        else
            problem.goals = kept

string listed(string heading, const string[] items)
    return heading + " " + (if #items == 0 then "-" else items.join(" "))

string number_list(const int[] items)
    if #items == 0
        return "-"
    ordered := items.sorted()
    string[] words := []
    for item := ordered[]
        words = words.append(string(item))
    return words.join(",")

string h_text(int value)
    return if value >= heuristics.INFINITY then "inf" else string(value)

string h_values(const int[] items)
    names := ["goalcount", "hmax", "hadd", "ff", "lmcount"]
    string[] words := []
    for: position < 5
        words = words.append("{names[position]}={h_text(items[position])}")
    return words.join(" ")

int cost(const grounding.Grounding graph, const int[] plan)
    total := 0
    for action := plan[]
        total += graph.actions[action].cost
    return total

string[] action_texts(const grounding.Grounding graph, const int[] plan)
    string[] result := []
    for action := plan[]
        result = result.append(graph.actions[action].text())
    return result

string[] domain_report(const pddl.Domain domain)
    lines := ["== domain {domain.name} =="]
    lines = lines.concat(domain.diagnostics)
    for type_name := domain.type_order[]
        chain := [type_name]
        current := type_name
        while current != "object"
            current = pddl.required(domain.parents, current)
            chain = chain.append(current)
        lines = lines.append("type {chain.join(" < ")}")
    fluent := grounding.fluents(domain)
    for declaration := domain.predicates[]
        kind := if pddl.has(fluent, declaration.name) then "fluent" else "static"
        lines = lines.append("predicate {declaration.name}/{#declaration.types} {kind}")
    for schema := domain.actions[]
        adds := 0
        deletes := 0
        for effect := schema.effects[]
            if effect.negative
                deletes += 1
            else
                adds += 1
        lines = lines.append("action {schema.name}/{#schema.parameters} cost={schema.cost} pre={#schema.pre} add={adds} del={deletes}")
    return lines

string[] grounding_report(const pddl.Domain domain, const pddl.Problem problem, const grounding.Grounding graph)
    lines := ["", "== problem {problem.name} =="]
    lines = lines.concat(problem.diagnostics).append("objects: {#problem.objects}")
    for type_name := domain.type_order[]
        string[] names := []
        for entry := problem.objects[]
            if grounding.subtype(domain, entry.type, type_name)
                names = names.append(entry.name)
        lines = lines.append(listed("  {type_name}:", names))
    lines = lines.append("static facts: {graph.static_count}")
    candidates := 0
    for: position < int(#domain.actions)
        pddl.Schema schema := domain.actions[position]
        stats := graph.stats[position]
        candidates += stats[1]
        lines = lines.append("schema {schema.name}: assignments={stats[0]} candidates={stats[1]} reachable={stats[2]}")
    lines = lines.append("candidates: {candidates} reachable: {#graph.actions}")
    lines = lines.append("facts: {#graph.facts} init: {#graph.initial} goals: {#graph.goals}")
    for item := graph.unreachable[]
        lines = lines.append("unreachable goal: {item.text()}")
    string[] predicate_counts := []
    for declaration := domain.predicates[]
        if pddl.has(graph.fluent, declaration.name)
            count := 0
            for item := graph.facts[]
                if item.predicate == declaration.name
                    count += 1
            predicate_counts = predicate_counts.append("{declaration.name}={count}")
    lines = lines.append(listed("facts by predicate:", predicate_counts)).append("facts:")
    for: position < int(#graph.facts)
        lines = lines.append("  {position} {graph.facts[position].text()}")
    lines = lines.append("actions:")
    for: position < int(#graph.actions)
        grounding.Action action := graph.actions[position]
        lines = lines.append("  {position} {action.text()} cost={action.cost} pre={number_list(action.pre)} neg={number_list(action.neg)} add={number_list(action.add)} del={number_list(action.del)}")
    return lines

class Validation(string status, string[] messages, int correct)
    string verdict()
        return if status == "valid" then "valid {messages[0]}" else "{status}: {messages[0]}"

Validation validate_steps(const pddl.Domain domain, const pddl.Problem problem, const pddl.Atom[] steps)
    pddl.Atom[] world := problem.initial
    total := 0
    table := type_table(problem.objects)
    for: position < int(#steps)
        step := steps[position]
        pddl.Schema | none selected := none
        for schema := domain.actions[]
            if schema.name == step.predicate
                selected = schema
                break
        match selected
            pddl.Schema schema
                string[] expected := []
                for parameter := schema.parameters[]
                    expected = expected.append(parameter.type)
                match arguments(domain, step.terms, expected, table, "object")
                    string message
                        return Validation("invalid", ["step {position + 1} {step.text()}: {message}"], position)
                    none
                        map<string, string> bindings
                        for: index < int(#schema.parameters)
                            .bindings.set(schema.parameters[index].name, step.terms[index])
                        for original := schema.pre[]
                            entry := pddl.substitute(original, bindings)
                            truth := if entry.atom.predicate == "=" then entry.atom.terms[0] == entry.atom.terms[1] else pddl.has(world, entry.atom)
                            if truth == entry.negative
                                return Validation("invalid", ["step {position + 1} {step.text()}: precondition {entry.text()} is false"], position)
                        pddl.Atom[] adds := []
                        pddl.Atom[] deletes := []
                        for effect := schema.effects[]
                            item := pddl.replace(effect.atom, bindings)
                            if effect.negative
                                deletes = deletes.append(item)
                            else
                                adds = adds.append(item)
                        world = pddl.unique(pddl.subtract(world, deletes).concat(adds))
                        total += schema.cost
            none
                return Validation("invalid", ["step {position + 1} {step.text()}: unknown action {step.predicate}"], position)
    string[] missing := []
    for item := problem.goals[]
        if not pddl.has(world, item)
            missing = missing.append("unsatisfied goal {item.text()}")
    if #missing > 0
        return Validation("goal not reached", missing, int(#steps))
    return Validation("valid", ["length={#steps} cost={total}"], int(#steps))

pddl.Atom[] plan_steps(const grounding.Grounding graph, const int[] plan)
    pddl.Atom[] result := []
    for index := plan[]
        result = result.append(pddl.Atom(graph.actions[index].name, graph.actions[index].args))
    return result

int[] map_steps(const grounding.Grounding graph, const pddl.Atom[] steps)
    int[] result := []
    for step := steps[]
        for: position < int(#graph.actions)
            grounding.Action action := graph.actions[position]
            if action.name == step.predicate and action.args == step.terms
                result = result.append(position)
                break
    return result

bool interfere(const grounding.Action first, const grounding.Action second)
    return pddl.overlaps(first.del, second.pre.concat(second.add)) or pddl.overlaps(second.del, first.pre.concat(first.add)) or pddl.overlaps(first.add, second.neg) or pddl.overlaps(second.add, first.neg)

int[][] parallel_layers(const grounding.Grounding graph, const int[] plan)
    int[] levels := []
    count := 0
    for: position < int(#plan)
        grounding.Action current := graph.actions[plan[position]]
        level := 0
        for: previous < position
            grounding.Action earlier := graph.actions[plan[previous]]
            if pddl.overlaps(earlier.add, current.pre) or pddl.overlaps(earlier.del, current.neg) or interfere(earlier, current)
                if levels[previous] > level
                    level = levels[previous]
        levels = levels.append(level + 1)
        if level + 1 > count
            count = level + 1
    int[][] layers := array(nat(count), fill = [])
    for: position < int(#plan)
        index := levels[position] - 1
        layers[index] = layers[index].append(plan[position])
    return layers

string parallel_verdict(const grounding.Grounding graph, const int[][] layers)
    state := graph.initial
    for: position < int(#layers)
        layer := layers[position]
        for: first < int(#layer)
            if not search.applicable(graph.actions[layer[first]], state)
                return "invalid at layer {position + 1}"
            for: first + 1 <= second < int(#layer)
                if interfere(graph.actions[layer[first]], graph.actions[layer[second]])
                    return "invalid at layer {position + 1}"
        int[] deletes := []
        int[] adds := []
        for action := layer[]
            deletes = deletes.concat(graph.actions[action].del)
            adds = adds.concat(graph.actions[action].add)
        state = pddl.unique(pddl.subtract(state, deletes).concat(adds)).sorted()
    return if pddl.contains_all(state, graph.goals) then "valid" else "goal not reached"

int[] improve(const grounding.Grounding graph, const int[] input_plan)
    plan := input_plan
    position := 0
    while position < int(#plan)
        state := graph.initial
        int[] next := []
        for: prefix < position
            state = search.apply(graph.actions[plan[prefix]], state)
            next = next.append(plan[prefix])
        for: position + 1 <= suffix < int(#plan)
            action := plan[suffix]
            if search.applicable(graph.actions[action], state)
                state = search.apply(graph.actions[action], state)
                next = next.append(action)
        if pddl.contains_all(state, graph.goals)
            plan = next
        else
            position += 1
    return plan

class Transformed(grounding.Action[] actions, int[] initial, int complements)

Transformed transformed(const grounding.Grounding graph)
    int[] negatives := []
    for action := graph.actions[]
        negatives = pddl.unique(negatives.concat(action.neg))
    negatives = negatives.sorted()
    mapping := array(#graph.facts, fill = -1)
    initial := graph.initial
    for: position < int(#negatives)
        fact := negatives[position]
        mapping[fact] = int(#graph.facts) + position
        if not pddl.has(initial, fact)
            initial = initial.append(mapping[fact])
    grounding.Action[] actions := []
    for original := graph.actions[]
        grounding.Action action := original
        for fact := original.neg[]
            action.pre = pddl.unique(action.pre.append(mapping[fact]))
        for fact := original.del[]
            if mapping[fact] >= 0
                action.add = pddl.unique(action.add.append(mapping[fact]))
        for fact := original.add[]
            if mapping[fact] >= 0
                action.del = pddl.unique(action.del.append(mapping[fact]))
        actions = actions.append(action)
    return Transformed(actions, initial.sorted(), int(#negatives))

class Run(string algorithm, string heuristic)
    string tag()
        return "{algorithm} {heuristic}"

class Params(budget := 0, weight := 0, limit := 0, Run[] runs := [], repair := Run("", ""))
class Candidate(string problem, string label, pddl.Atom[] steps := [])

Params read_params()
    result := Params()
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/params.txt"))
    lines := text.split(NL)
    for line := lines[]
        if line == "" or line.starts_with("#")
            continue
        words := line.split(" ")
        if words[0] == "budget"
            result.budget = int(words[1])
        elif words[0] == "weight"
            result.weight = int(words[1])
        elif words[0] == "graphplan"
            result.limit = int(words[1])
        elif words[0] == "run"
            result.runs = result.runs.append(Run(words[1], words[2]))
        else
            result.repair = Run(words[1], words[2])
    return result

Candidate[] read_candidates()
    Candidate[] result := []
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/candidates.txt"))
    lines := text.split(NL)
    for line := lines[]
        if line == "" or line.starts_with("#")
            continue
        if line.starts_with("plan ")
            words := line.split(" ")
            result = result.append(Candidate(words[1], words[2]))
        elif line != "end"
            words := line[1:<int(#line) - 1].split(" ")
            index := int(#result) - 1
            result[index].steps = result[index].steps.append(pddl.Atom(words[0], words[1:<int(#words)]))
    return result

class Seen(int[] plan, string tag)
class PlanBlock(string[] lines, string[] validation, bool valid)

PlanBlock plan_block(const pddl.Domain domain, const pddl.Problem problem, const grounding.Grounding graph, const int[] plan, string tag, const int[] landmarks, Seen[] &seen)
    same := ""
    for entry := seen[]
        if entry.plan == plan
            same = " (same as {entry.tag})"
            break
    if same == ""
        seen = seen.append(Seen(plan, tag))
    lines := ["plan: length={#plan} cost={cost(graph, plan)}{same}"]
    for: position < int(#plan)
        lines = lines.append("  {position + 1} {graph.actions[plan[position]].text()}")
    string[] schemas := []
    for: source < int(#domain.actions)
        count := 0
        for action := plan[]
            if graph.actions[action].source == source
                count += 1
        if count > 0
            schemas = schemas.append("{domain.actions[source].name}={count}")
    lines = lines.append(listed("schemas:", schemas))
    layers := parallel_layers(graph, plan)
    lines = lines.append("parallel: layers={#layers}")
    for: position < int(#layers)
        lines = lines.append(listed("  {position + 1}:", action_texts(graph, layers[position])))
    improved := improve(graph, plan)
    lines = lines.append("improved: length={#improved} cost={cost(graph, improved)} removed={#plan - #improved}")
    if #improved < #plan
        for: position < int(#improved)
            lines = lines.append("  {position + 1} {graph.actions[improved[position]].text()}")
    state := graph.initial
    int[] reached := []
    for action := plan[]
        state = search.apply(graph.actions[action], state)
        reached = pddl.unique(reached.concat(pddl.intersect(state, landmarks)))
    lines = lines.append("landmarks reached: {#reached}/{#landmarks}")
    int[] missed := pddl.subtract(landmarks, reached).sorted()
    for fact := missed[]
        lines = lines.append("  missed {graph.facts[fact].text()}")
    original := validate_steps(domain, problem, plan_steps(graph, plan))
    checked := validate_steps(domain, problem, plan_steps(graph, improved))
    validation := ["{tag}: {original.verdict()}", "  parallel: {parallel_verdict(graph, layers)}", "  improved: {checked.verdict()}"]
    return PlanBlock(lines, validation, original.status == "valid")

string[] profile(const grounding.Grounding graph, const int[] plan, string tag)
    lines := ["-- profile ({tag}) --"]
    state := graph.initial
    remaining := cost(graph, plan)
    over := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    for: position < int(#plan) + 1
        values := heuristics.values(graph, state)
        for: index < 5
            if values[index] > remaining
                over[index] += 1
        lines = lines.append("  {position}: h*={remaining} {h_values(values)}")
        if position < int(#plan)
            state = search.apply(graph.actions[plan[position]], state)
            remaining -= graph.actions[plan[position]].cost
    lines = lines.append("overestimates: {h_values(over)}").append("-- causal links ({tag}) --")
    suppliers := array(#graph.facts, fill = 0)
    for: position < int(#plan)
        grounding.Action action := graph.actions[plan[position]]
        string[] links := []
        ordered := action.pre.sorted()
        for fact := ordered[]
            links = links.append("{graph.facts[fact].text()}<-{suppliers[fact]}")
        lines = lines.append(listed("  {position + 1} {action.text()}:", links))
        for fact := action.add[]
            suppliers[fact] = position + 1
    string[] links := []
    ordered := graph.goals.sorted()
    for fact := ordered[]
        links = links.append("{graph.facts[fact].text()}<-{suppliers[fact]}")
    return lines.append(listed("  goal:", links))

string result_line(const search.Result result, bool unreachable)
    if unreachable
        return "result: FAIL (unreachable goal)"
    if result.status == "solved"
        return "result: solved expanded={result.expanded} generated={result.generated}"
    return "result: FAIL ({result.status}) expanded={result.expanded} generated={result.generated}"

void write_output(string name, const string[] lines)
    bool exists := file.is_directory("output")
    if not exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    string text := if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL
    writer1 := file.write("output/{name}")
    .writer1(text)

class Best(int | none value)

void run_program()
    domain := pddl.read_domain()
    validate_domain(&domain)
    pddl.Problem[] problems := pddl.read_problems()
    for: position < int(#problems)
        validate_problem(domain, &problems[position])
    params := read_params()
    grounding.Grounding[] grounds := []
    for problem := problems[]
        grounds = grounds.append(grounding.ground(domain, problem))
    string[] tags := []
    for setting := params.runs[]
        tags = tags.append(setting.tag())
    tags = tags.append("graphplan")
    grounding_lines := domain_report(domain)
    string[] plans := []
    string[] graph_lines := []
    string[] validation := []
    comparison := ["problem,algorithm,heuristic,length,cost,expanded,generated"]
    string[] problem_summary := []
    int[][] tag_stats := array(#tags, fill = [0, 0, 0, 0])
    Best[] bests := []
    analyzed := 0
    valid_plans := 0
    for: problem_index < int(#problems)
        problem := problems[problem_index]
        graph := grounds[problem_index]
        unreachable := #graph.unreachable > 0
        grounding_lines = grounding_lines.concat(grounding_report(domain, problem, graph))
        heading := "== problem {problem.name} =="
        plans = plans.append(heading)
        validation = validation.append(heading)
        graph_lines = graph_lines.append(heading)
        int[] landmarks := []
        if unreachable
            plans = plans.append("initial h: unreachable goal")
        else
            plans = plans.append("initial h: {h_values(heuristics.values(graph, graph.initial))}")
            match heuristics.landmarks(graph, graph.initial)
                int[] found
                    landmarks = found
                none
                    landmarks = []
            plans = plans.append("landmarks: {#landmarks}")
            for fact := landmarks[]
                plans = plans.append("  {graph.facts[fact].text()}")
            relaxed_plan := heuristics.relaxed(graph, graph.initial)
            plans = plans.append("relaxed plan: length={#relaxed_plan.plan} cost={h_text(relaxed_plan.value)}")
            for action := relaxed_plan.plan[]
                plans = plans.append("  {graph.actions[action].text()}")
            plans = plans.append(listed("helpful:", action_texts(graph, relaxed_plan.helpful)))
        search.Result[] results := []
        for setting := params.runs[]
            result := if unreachable then search.Result("unreachable goal") else search.run(graph, graph.initial, setting.algorithm, setting.heuristic, params.budget, params.weight)
            results = results.append(result)
        if unreachable
            graph_lines = graph_lines.append("result: FAIL (unreachable goal)")
            results = results.append(search.Result("unreachable goal"))
        else
            changed := transformed(graph)
            graph_result := graphplan.run(changed.actions, changed.initial, graph.goals, params.limit)
            graph_lines = graph_lines.append("complementary facts: {changed.complements}").concat(graph_result.records)
            result := graph_result.result
            if result.status == "solved"
                graph_lines = graph_lines.append("result: solved levels={#graph_result.layers} length={#result.plan} cost={cost(graph, result.plan)} searched={result.expanded} memo_hits={graph_result.hits} tried={result.generated}")
                for: position < int(#graph_result.layers)
                    graph_lines = graph_lines.append(listed("layer {position + 1}:", action_texts(graph, graph_result.layers[position])))
            else
                graph_lines = graph_lines.append("result: FAIL ({result.status}) searched={result.expanded} memo_hits={graph_result.hits} tried={result.generated}")
            results = results.append(result)
        graph_lines = graph_lines.append("")
        int | none best := none
        solved := 0
        for result := results[]
            if result.status == "solved"
                solved += 1
                value := cost(graph, result.plan)
                match best
                    int old
                        if old < value
                            value = old
                    none
                        void
                best = value
        best_text := "-"
        match best
            int value
                best_text = string(value)
            none
                best_text = "-"
        bests = bests.append(Best(best))
        int | none proof := none
        for: position < int(#params.runs)
            setting := params.runs[position]
            if ((setting.algorithm == "ucs" and setting.heuristic == "none") or (setting.algorithm == "astar" and setting.heuristic == "hmax")) and results[position].status == "solved"
                proof = position
                break
        optimal := "unknown"
        for result := results[]
            if pddl.has(["unreachable goal", "dead end", "exhausted", "unreachable"], result.status)
                optimal = "none"
        match proof
            int position
                optimal = string(cost(graph, results[position].plan))
            none
                optimal = optimal
        problem_summary = problem_summary.append("{problem.name}: solved={solved}/{#results} best={best_text} optimal={optimal}")
        Seen[] seen := []
        for: position < int(#results)
            result := results[position]
            plans = plans.append("-- {tags[position]} --").append(result_line(result, unreachable))
            tag_stats[position][2] += result.expanded
            tag_stats[position][3] += result.generated
            setting := if position < int(#params.runs) then params.runs[position] else Run("graphplan", "none")
            length_text := "-"
            cost_text := "-"
            if result.status == "solved"
                tag_stats[position][0] += 1
                cost_text = string(cost(graph, result.plan))
                if cost_text == best_text
                    tag_stats[position][1] += 1
                block := plan_block(domain, problem, graph, result.plan, tags[position], landmarks, &seen)
                plans = plans.concat(block.lines)
                validation = validation.concat(block.validation)
                analyzed += 1
                if block.valid
                    valid_plans += 1
                length_text = string(#result.plan)
            comparison = comparison.append("{problem.name},{setting.algorithm},{setting.heuristic},{length_text},{cost_text},{result.expanded},{result.generated}")
        match proof
            int position
                plans = plans.concat(profile(graph, results[position].plan, tags[position]))
            none
                plans = plans
        plans = plans.append("")
        validation = validation.append("")
    plans = plans.append("== summary ==").concat(problem_summary)
    for: position < int(#tags)
        stats := tag_stats[position]
        plans = plans.append("{tags[position]}: solved={stats[0]} best={stats[1]} expanded={stats[2]} generated={stats[3]}")
    validation = validation.append("== candidates ==")
    candidates := read_candidates()
    valid_candidates := 0
    for: candidate_index < int(#candidates)
        candidate := candidates[candidate_index]
        problem_index := 0
        while problems[problem_index].name != candidate.problem
            problem_index += 1
        problem := problems[problem_index]
        graph := grounds[problem_index]
        checked := validate_steps(domain, problem, candidate.steps)
        prefix := "candidate {candidate_index + 1} {problem.name} {candidate.label}:"
        if checked.status == "valid"
            valid_candidates += 1
            validation = validation.append("{prefix} {checked.verdict()}")
            mapped := map_steps(graph, candidate.steps)
            improved := improve(graph, mapped)
            best_text := "-"
            match bests[problem_index].value
                int value
                    best_text = string(value)
                none
                    best_text = "-"
            validation = validation.append("  improved: length={#improved} cost={cost(graph, improved)} removed={#mapped - #improved} best known={best_text}")
        else
            validation = validation.append("{prefix} {checked.status}")
            for message := checked.messages[]
                validation = validation.append("  {message}")
            if #graph.unreachable > 0
                validation = validation.append("  repair: FAIL (unreachable goal)")
                continue
            mapped := map_steps(graph, candidate.steps[0:<checked.correct])
            state := graph.initial
            for action := mapped[]
                state = search.apply(graph.actions[action], state)
            repair := search.run(graph, state, params.repair.algorithm, params.repair.heuristic, params.budget, params.weight)
            if repair.status != "solved"
                validation = validation.append("  repair: FAIL ({repair.status})")
            else
                int[] repaired_plan := mapped.concat(repair.plan)
                repaired := validate_steps(domain, problem, plan_steps(graph, repaired_plan))
                validation = validation.append("  repair: kept={#mapped} added={#repair.plan} {repaired.verdict()}")
                for: position < int(#repaired_plan)
                    validation = validation.append("    {position + 1} {graph.actions[repaired_plan[position]].text()}")
    validation = validation.concat(["", "== summary ==", "plans: {analyzed} valid: {valid_plans}", "candidates: {#candidates} valid: {valid_candidates}"])
    write_output("grounding.txt", grounding_lines)
    write_output("plans.txt", plans)
    write_output("graphplan.txt", graph_lines)
    write_output("validation.txt", validation)
    write_output("comparison.csv", comparison)

if main
    run_program()

class Expression(string word, int[] children := [])
class Syntax(Expression[] nodes := [], int[] roots := [])
class Atom(string predicate, string[] terms := [])
    string text()
        words := [predicate]
        words = words.concat(terms)
        return "({words.join(" ")})"

class Literal(Atom atom, negative := false)
    string text()
        return if negative then "(not {atom.text()})" else atom.text()

class Typed(string name, string type)
class Predicate(string name, string[] types)
class Schema(string name, Typed[] parameters := [], Literal[] pre := [], Literal[] effects := [], cost := 1)
class Domain(string name, type_order := ["object"], parents := map<string, string>(), Predicate[] predicates := [], Schema[] actions := [], string[] diagnostics := [])
class Problem(string name, Typed[] objects := [], Atom[] initial := [], Atom[] goals := [], string[] diagnostics := [])

bool has<T>(const T[] items, T sought)
    for item := items[]
        if item == sought
            return true
    return false

T[] unique<T>(const T[] items)
    T[] result := []
    for item := items[]
        if not has(result, item)
            result = result.append(item)
    return result

T[] subtract<T>(const T[] first, const T[] second)
    T[] result := []
    for item := first[]
        if not has(second, item)
            result = result.append(item)
    return result

T[] intersect<T>(const T[] first, const T[] second)
    T[] result := []
    for item := first[]
        if has(second, item)
            result = result.append(item)
    return result

bool contains_all<T>(const T[] items, const T[] required)
    for item := required[]
        if not has(items, item)
            return false
    return true

bool overlaps<T>(const T[] first, const T[] second)
    for item := first[]
        if has(second, item)
            return true
    return false

int compare(const int[] first, const int[] second)
    count := if #first < #second then int(#first) else int(#second)
    for: position < count
        if first[position] != second[position]
            return if first[position] < second[position] then -1 else 1
    return if #first < #second then -1 elif #first > #second then 1 else 0

string | error required(const map<string, string> values, string key)
    match values.get(key)
        string found
            return found
        none
            return error("missing binding {key}")

Atom replace(const Atom original, const map<string, string> values)
    string[] terms := []
    for term := original.terms[]
        value := required(values, term)
        terms = terms.append(value)
    return Atom(original.predicate, terms)

Literal substitute(const Literal original, const map<string, string> values)
    return Literal(replace(original.atom, values), original.negative)

int read_expression(const string[] tokens, int &position, Syntax &syntax)
    token := tokens[position]
    position += 1
    int[] children := []
    if token == "("
        while tokens[position] != ")"
            child := read_expression(tokens, &position, &syntax)
            children = children.append(child)
        position += 1
        token = ""
    index := int(#syntax.nodes)
    syntax.nodes = syntax.nodes.append(Expression(token, children))
    return index

Syntax expressions(string path)
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    string[] tokens := []
    lines := text.split(NL)
    for line := lines[]
        word := ""
        for: position < int(#line)
            character := line[position]
            if character == ";"
                break
            if character == " " or character == "(" or character == ")"
                if word != ""
                    tokens = tokens.append(word)
                    word = ""
                if character != " "
                    tokens = tokens.append(character)
            else
                word += character
        if word != ""
            tokens = tokens.append(word)
    syntax := Syntax()
    position := 0
    while position < int(#tokens)
        root := read_expression(tokens, &position, &syntax)
        syntax.roots = syntax.roots.append(root)
    return syntax

Typed[] typed(const Syntax syntax, const int[] nodes)
    Typed[] result := []
    string[] pending := []
    position := 0
    while position < int(#nodes)
        word := syntax.nodes[nodes[position]].word
        if word == "-"
            position += 1
            type := syntax.nodes[nodes[position]].word
            for name := pending[]
                result = result.append(Typed(name, type))
            pending = []
        else
            pending = pending.append(word)
        position += 1
    for name := pending[]
        result = result.append(Typed(name, "object"))
    return result

int[] conjunction(const Syntax syntax, int node)
    children := syntax.nodes[node].children
    if syntax.nodes[children[0]].word == "and"
        return children[1:<int(#children)]
    return [node]

Atom atom(const Syntax syntax, int node)
    children := syntax.nodes[node].children
    string[] terms := []
    for: 1 <= position < int(#children)
        terms = terms.append(syntax.nodes[children[position]].word)
    return Atom(syntax.nodes[children[0]].word, terms)

Literal literal(const Syntax syntax, int node)
    children := syntax.nodes[node].children
    if syntax.nodes[children[0]].word == "not"
        return Literal(atom(syntax, children[1]), true)
    return Literal(atom(syntax, node))

Domain read_domain()
    syntax := expressions("input/domain.txt")
    root := syntax.nodes[syntax.roots[0]].children
    domain := Domain(syntax.nodes[syntax.nodes[root[1]].children[1]].word)
    for: 2 <= index < int(#root)
        section := syntax.nodes[root[index]].children
        heading := syntax.nodes[section[0]].word
        if heading == ":types"
            for: 1 <= position < int(#section)
                word := syntax.nodes[section[position]].word
                if word != "-" and not has(domain.type_order, word)
                    domain.type_order = domain.type_order.append(word)
                    if word != "object"
                        .domain.parents.set(word, "object")
            declared := typed(syntax, section[1:<int(#section)])
            for entry := declared[]
                .domain.parents.set(entry.name, entry.type)
        elif heading == ":predicates"
            for: 1 <= position < int(#section)
                declaration := syntax.nodes[section[position]].children
                arguments := typed(syntax, declaration[1:<int(#declaration)])
                string[] types := []
                for entry := arguments[]
                    types = types.append(entry.type)
                domain.predicates = domain.predicates.append(Predicate(syntax.nodes[declaration[0]].word, types))
        elif heading == ":action"
            action := Schema(syntax.nodes[section[1]].word)
            position := 2
            while position < int(#section)
                keyword := syntax.nodes[section[position]].word
                value := section[position + 1]
                if keyword == ":parameters"
                    action.parameters = typed(syntax, syntax.nodes[value].children)
                elif keyword == ":precondition"
                    conditions := conjunction(syntax, value)
                    for condition := conditions[]
                        action.pre = action.pre.append(literal(syntax, condition))
                else
                    effects := conjunction(syntax, value)
                    for effect := effects[]
                        children := syntax.nodes[effect].children
                        if syntax.nodes[children[0]].word == "increase"
                            action.cost = int(syntax.nodes[children[2]].word)
                        else
                            action.effects = action.effects.append(literal(syntax, effect))
                position += 2
            domain.actions = domain.actions.append(action)
    return domain

Problem[] read_problems()
    syntax := expressions("input/problems.txt")
    Problem[] problems := []
    for node := syntax.roots[]
        root := syntax.nodes[node].children
        problem := Problem(syntax.nodes[syntax.nodes[root[1]].children[1]].word)
        for: 2 <= position < int(#root)
            section := syntax.nodes[root[position]].children
            heading := syntax.nodes[section[0]].word
            if heading == ":objects"
                problem.objects = typed(syntax, section[1:<int(#section)])
            elif heading == ":init"
                for: 1 <= item < int(#section)
                    problem.initial = problem.initial.append(atom(syntax, section[item]))
            elif heading == ":goal"
                goals := conjunction(syntax, section[1])
                for goal := goals[]
                    problem.goals = problem.goals.append(atom(syntax, goal))
        problems = problems.append(problem)
    return problems

import pddl = "./pddl_parser.qui"
import grounding = "./grounding.qui"
import heuristics = "./heuristics.qui"

class Result(string status, int[] plan := [], expanded := 0, generated := 0)
class Node(int[] state, int cost, int depth, parent := -1, action := -1)
class Key(int score, int estimate, int serial)
class Local(int[] state, int[] path)

bool applicable(const grounding.Action action, const int[] state)
    return pddl.contains_all(state, action.pre) and not pddl.overlaps(state, action.neg)

int[] apply(const grounding.Action action, const int[] state)
    return pddl.unique(pddl.subtract(state, action.del).concat(action.add)).sorted()

string state_key(const int[] state)
    string[] words := []
    ordered := state.sorted()
    for fact := ordered[]
        words = words.append(string(fact))
    return words.join(",")

bool less(const Key first, const Key second)
    return first.score < second.score or (first.score == second.score and (first.estimate < second.estimate or (first.estimate == second.estimate and first.serial < second.serial)))

void push(Key[] &heap, const Key entry)
    heap = heap.append(entry)
    position := int(#heap) - 1
    while position > 0
        parent := (position - 1) / 2
        if not less(heap[position], heap[parent])
            break
        saved := heap[parent]
        heap[parent] = heap[position]
        heap[position] = saved
        position = parent

Key pop(Key[] &heap)
    result := heap[0]
    count := int(#heap) - 1
    last := heap[count]
    heap = heap[0:<count]
    if count == 0
        return result
    heap[0] = last
    position := 0
    while position * 2 + 1 < count
        child := position * 2 + 1
        if child + 1 < count and less(heap[child + 1], heap[child])
            child += 1
        if not less(heap[child], heap[position])
            break
        saved := heap[position]
        heap[position] = heap[child]
        heap[child] = saved
        position = child
    return result

Key priority(string algorithm, int cost, int depth, int estimate, int serial, int weight)
    score := if algorithm == "bfs" then depth elif algorithm == "ucs" then cost elif algorithm == "gbfs" then estimate elif algorithm == "astar" then cost + estimate else cost + weight * estimate
    return Key(score, estimate, serial)

Result ehc(const grounding.Grounding graph, const int[] start, string heuristic, int budget)
    result := Result("stuck")
    current := start
    current_h := heuristics.value(graph, current, heuristic)
    if current_h >= heuristics.INFINITY
        result.status = "dead end"
        return result
    while true
        if pddl.contains_all(current, graph.goals)
            result.status = "solved"
            return result
        queue := [Local(current, [])]
        distinct<string> visited
        .visited.add(state_key(current))
        position := 0
        improved := false
        while position < int(#queue) and not improved
            entry := queue[position]
            position += 1
            if result.expanded == budget
                result.status = "budget"
                return result
            result.expanded += 1
            relaxed_plan := heuristics.relaxed(graph, entry.state)
            for action := relaxed_plan.helpful[]
                result.generated += 1
                next := apply(graph.actions[action], entry.state)
                key := state_key(next)
                if visited.has(key)
                    continue
                .visited.add(key)
                estimate := heuristics.value(graph, next, heuristic)
                if estimate >= heuristics.INFINITY
                    continue
                path := entry.path.append(action)
                if estimate < current_h
                    current = next
                    current_h = estimate
                    result.plan = result.plan.concat(path)
                    improved = true
                    break
                queue = queue.append(Local(next, path))
        if not improved
            return result

Result run(const grounding.Grounding graph, const int[] start, string algorithm, string heuristic, int budget, int weight)
    if algorithm == "ehc"
        return ehc(graph, start, heuristic, budget)
    result := Result("exhausted")
    initial_h := heuristics.value(graph, start, heuristic)
    if initial_h >= heuristics.INFINITY
        result.status = "dead end"
        return result
    nodes := [Node(start, 0, 0)]
    frontier := [priority(algorithm, 0, 0, initial_h, 0, weight)]
    map<string, int> table
    .table.set(state_key(start), 0)
    reopening := algorithm == "ucs" or algorithm == "astar" or algorithm == "wastar"
    while #frontier != 0
        selected := pop(&frontier)
        node := nodes[selected.serial]
        if reopening
            match table.get(state_key(node.state))
                int old
                    if node.cost > old
                        continue
                none
                    continue
        if pddl.contains_all(node.state, graph.goals)
            result.status = "solved"
            current := selected.serial
            int[] reversed := []
            while nodes[current].parent >= 0
                reversed = reversed.append(nodes[current].action)
                current = nodes[current].parent
            result.plan = reversed[::-1]
            return result
        if result.expanded == budget
            result.status = "budget"
            return result
        result.expanded += 1
        for: action < int(#graph.actions)
            if not applicable(graph.actions[action], node.state)
                continue
            result.generated += 1
            next := apply(graph.actions[action], node.state)
            int next_cost := node.cost + graph.actions[action].cost
            key := state_key(next)
            discard := false
            match table.get(key)
                int old
                    discard = not reopening or old <= next_cost
                none
                    discard = false
            if discard
                continue
            .table.set(key, next_cost)
            estimate := heuristics.value(graph, next, heuristic)
            if estimate >= heuristics.INFINITY
                continue
            serial := int(#nodes)
            nodes = nodes.append(Node(next, next_cost, node.depth + 1, selected.serial, action))
            push(&frontier, priority(algorithm, next_cost, node.depth + 1, estimate, serial, weight))
    return result
